card_name: HDFC Bank World MasterCard Credit Card
fee_details:
- 1st Year: Rs. 0 on spending Rs. 50,000 or above within 90 days
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs. 0 or on annual spend of Rs.75,000
reward_structure:
- 2 Points/Rs. 150 spent
- 50% more points on spends of total amount >=Rs.75000 in a statement cycle
key_highlights:
- Earn Rewards Points (RP) on every eligible transaction with the HDFC World MasterCard. You can convert the points to air miles for your flight tickets or cashback and gifts.
- Earn 2 Reward Points for every Rs. 150 spent on the card with the possibility of earning additional points.
- Get your joining fee for the first year refunded on spending Rs.15000 within 3 months of card membership.

benefits_features.Travel benefits: Redeem reward points for flight tickets or cashback and gifts
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: The card has a renewal fee. The fee is Rs. 0 if you spend Rs.75,000 in a year

how_tos.How to Redeem Rewards Points:
You can redeem your earned points via two options: Offline or Online. For offline, you can send a request via post and for online, you can visit NetBanking. Let’s look at both these options in detail.
Offline - Via Post/Mail:
Step 1: Check your credit card statement or your NetBanking account for your earned Reward Points.
Step 2: Select the rewards you want to redeem from the ‘Rewards catalogue’ available on our website, generate the coupon, and fill in the requested details.
Step 3: Download the ‘Rewards Redemption Coupon’ form available on the website, take a printout, and fill it.
Step 4: Submit the form via post to the address on the form.
Upon receiving your redemption request, the redeemed gifts will be delivered to your registered address in 15 to 20 business days.
Online - Via NetBanking:
Step 1: Log in to your HDFC credit card NetBanking account using your username and password.
Step 2: Click on the ‘Credit Card’ option located on top.
Step 3: Complete a one-time registration for your credit card by clicking on the ‘Register Now’ option and entering your Credit Card/PIN.
Step 4: Click on the ‘Redeem Reward Points’ option present on the left-hand side on the NetBanking home screen and then go on to continue to the Online Redemption portal.
Step 5: In the Online Redemption Homepage click on ‘Redeem Reward Points’.
Step 6: Select your desired ‘Points Range’ depending on your RP balance from the list of items. Category-wise, they have arranged the catalogue.
Step 7: Add the items you wish to exchange your points for in your shopping cart.
Step 8: Click ‘Proceed to Shopping Cart’ option to see your selected items and edit the quantity by using the ‘Editing’ option.
Step 9: Read ‘Terms and Conditions’, thoroughly and check the box to confirm the same.
Step 10: Click on the ‘Redeem’ option to complete the redemption process. You will get a Redemption Order Number. Seven-number based issued discrepancy in the future.
The redeemed items will be sent to the address you see on the redemption page. If you wish for the items to be delivered to another address in case of relocation, do not continue with the redemption. First, call our customer service number and request a change in your registered address. Once the address change has been updated, go ahead with redeeming your Reward Points.

miscellaneous:
HDFC World MasterCard Credit Card
The credit limit offered on this HDFC credit card can be different for different individuals. This is because the credit limit is decided by the bank keeping in mind several factors including but not limited to age, employment status, income, other debt obligations, and credit score.
HDFC Bank at its sole discretion will decide the credit limit that you will have offered. You may also later request an increase in your credit limit under certain circumstances such as an increase in your income.

faqs.Does this card offer complimentary airpo: No, this offer only has complimentary airport access programs in which access to airport lounges was discontinued in 2017.
faqs.I have applied for this credit card. How: You can track the status of your credit card application on the bank's website. You will need your application reference number (16 digits) and your DOB details on mobile number to check your status.
faqs.Will I earn Rewards Points on paying my: Yes, you can earn payments on paying any premium and you will earn 80% RP. However, the maximum points you can earn per transaction is 2000 points.
faqs.Do the Rewards Points I earn expire? If: Yes, the RP you earn will expire in 2 years from the date of accumulation. For instance, if you earn your points in August 2023, then they will expire in August 2025.
faqs.Will my portable equipment be covered un: Yes, Personal portable equipment will be covered under the Fire and Burglary insurance protection offered on the card. However, the coverage limit for each item is limited to Rs.25,000.
